result.browser: Google Chrome headless, isolated temporary profile

fixture.kind: deterministically generated in-browser synthetic text; the user's novel file is not included in this browser run

measurements.editorReadyTimingBoundary: From after synthetic source generation to EditorHandle onReady; includes React/editor mount and initial visible-row setup, excludes text file reading, decoding, and source generation.

singleCharacterEdits.timingBoundary: Browser performance.now() from immediately before 50 sequential CDP Input.insertText calls until all 50 complete-document onChange callbacks have run; excludes the Node-side wall-clock CDP round-trip budget.

longSingleLine.assertion: Only fewer than 500 wrapped visual rows are mounted; Backspace and Undo preserve each tested grapheme.

coverage: full-source initialization with exact BOM, CRLF and trailing blank-line retention
bounded DOM line rendering
complete host onChange echo after input and paste
50 sequential single-character input edits and animation-frame gap observation
CDP-synthesized committed Chinese IME input
pending IME flush before Cmd/Ctrl+S, pointer-down outside the editor, and read-only transition
each tested pending IME composition is removed by one Undo; read-only rejects later edits while preserving earlier composition
copy and cut over virtualized source selections, including reverse direction
whole-document find and replace
screen click caret placement and pointer drag auto-scroll across virtual rows
Home, End, arrow, Shift+Arrow, platform word movement, select-all, and reverse selection
find-panel case-sensitive and whole-word replace-all with mixed CRLF/LF/CR source separators and Undo
find-panel regular-expression capture replacement and Undo
single-line 220k text and Backspace/Undo of ZWJ family emoji, combining accent, flag pair, and skin-tone modifier
Shift-Tab at the first source offset
read-only and inactive-document input rejection
external replacement resets stale history
flushContent accepts an external host snapshot before React renders and still commits newer pending native input
native LF insertion into CRLF text places the caret after the complete separator; the next character does not split the pair
Enter, literal Tab, Shift-Tab and Backspace plain-text behavior
unmount releases editor DOM and ready handle
canvas-context failure and ResizeObserver-constructor failure leave no partial root, driver registration, or document listeners
limitations: This is one synthetic-source headless-Chrome run, not a repeated performance distribution.
The 84 ms ready measurement excludes file I/O and UTF-8 decoding; it is not an end-to-end desktop open time.
CDP IME operations synthesize composition events; they do not verify a physical Chinese keyboard or operating-system input method.
The browser test verifies the complete onChange source callback, not native project storage, autosave, close/reopen, or conflict handling.
Copy and cut use synthetic ClipboardEvent/DataTransfer objects; pointer clicks and drags use CDP mouse input.
The exact original novel file remains for the separately planned desktop validation.
